description:
Top-level reactive if= STRUCTURAL absence (§17.1) — the false-state companion to reactive-toggle-show. @open seeds false and no input flips it, so the if=@open

does NOT exist in the DOM (removed, not display:none). Pins #panel count 0, mirroring the Tier-1 each per-row if= create-time-absence assertion at top level.
rationale: §17.1 an if=false element is absent from the DOM. With @open left false the panel must never materialize; a count:0 anchored assertion is impl-neutral (impl#1's private <template> if-anchor is not #panel).
